title: Question 8
author: 65197ebd8a6b1841b92c3592
chapter_outcomes: Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of ICT including: hardware and software, analogue and digital data, the main components of computer systems, operating systems, types of computer, emerging technologies

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of input and output devices including: characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of input devices, direct data entry and associated devices, output devices

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of storage devices and media including: characteristics, uses, media, advantages and disadvantages of magnetic, optical and solid-state storage devices and media

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of networks and the effects of using them including: router operation and purpose, common network devices, wi-fi and Bluetooth, cloud computing, common network environments, network types, security issues regarding data transfer, passwords, other authentication methods, anti-malware software, electronic conferencing

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of the effects of using IT including: the positive and negative effects of microprocessor-controlled devices in monitoring and controlling devices in the home and transport, potential health problems related to the prolonged use of IT equipment

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of ICT applications including: communication media, mobile communication, computer modelling, computer controlled systems, school management systems, booking systems, banking applications, computers in medicine, expert systems, computers in the retail industry, recognition systems, satellite systems

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of the systems life cycle including: analysis of the current system, system specification, design of file/data structures, input formats, output formats and validation routines, testing strategies and test data, system implementation methods, documentation (technical and user), evaluation of a solution

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of safety and security including: physical safety issues, data protection and personal data, eSafety when using the internet, email, social media, online gaming, threats to data (hacking, phishing, pharming, smishing, vishing, viruses, malware, card fraud), protection of data (biometrics, digital certificate, SSL, encryption, firewall, two-factor authentication, user id and password)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of audience appreciation including: showing a clear sense of audience and purpose, planning ICT solutions that are responsive to and respectful of the needs of an audience, copyright legislation

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of communication including: characteristics, uses and constraints of email communication, spam email, characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of using the internet, functionality of the internet (ISP, URL, hyperlink, web browser), use of search engines, evaluating information found on the internet, internet protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SSL), risks of using the internet

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of file management including: characteristics and uses of file formats, the need for generic file formats, the need to reduce file sizes for storage or transmission
Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of file size reduction including: recognising that reducing the file size can be achieved by reducing the image resolution or colour depth

Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the differences between hardware and software, the differences between analogue and digital data, the characteristics and differences between ROM and RAM, the characteristics and differences between input and output devices, the characteristics and differences between backing storage and internal memory, the characteristics, differences, advantages and disadvantages of different types of operating systems

Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of different types of computer, the impact of emerging technologies on everyday life
Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of storage devices and media

Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the characteristics, uses and issues relating to cloud computing, advantages and disadvantages of using cloud storage compared to other methods, the differences and similarities between Bluetooth and wi-fi, the characteristics, uses and purpose of an extranet, intranet and the internet, the differences between LAN, WLAN, WAN, the differences between strong and weak passwords, the characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of video-conferencing, audio-conferencing, web-conferencing
Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the causes of health issues and strategies for preventing them

Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the characteristics and uses of communication media, the characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of computer modelling, computer controlled systems, online booking systems, banking applications (ATM, EFT, credit/debit card transactions, cheques, internet banking), information systems in medicine, 3D printers in medicine, expert systems, computers in the retail industry (POS terminals, EFTPOS terminals), internet shopping, recognition systems (OMR, OCR, RFID, NFC, biometric recognition), satellite systems (GPS, satellite navigation, GIS, media communication systems)

Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of research methods (observation, interviews, questionnaires, examination of existing documents), the need to identify the inputs, outputs and processing of the current system, problems with the current system, the user and information requirements for the new system, the characteristics and use of validation routines, the definition, characteristics and use of test data using normal, abnormal and extreme data, the characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of the four methods of implementation (direct changeover, parallel running, pilot running, phased implementation), the characteristics, uses and purpose of technical and user documentation

Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the causes of safety issues and strategies for preventing them, the principles of a typical data protection act and why data protection legislation is required, characteristics of personal and sensitive data, the need for personal data to be kept confidential and protected, the need for eSafety when using the internet, email, social media, online gaming, characteristics and effect of threats to data, characteristics and methods of protecting data

Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the purpose and uses of a corporate house style, the need for copyright legislation and the principles of copyright relating to computer software, the methods that software producers employ to prevent software copyright legislation being broken
Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions about: the importance, characteristics and uses of verification and validation, the need for validation as well as verification
